facts.fact: Jingling 一开口就说姐姐根本不知道自己在干什么。
facts.anchor: “Just admit it, you have no idea what you’re doing,” Jingling said.

facts.fact: 她把生米、院里母鸡下的蛋和一片柚子叶盛进家里最好的碗当供品。
facts.anchor: Into their best serving bowl she had poured a precious a cup of uncooked rice, an egg from one of the hens in the yard and, for good measure, a pomelo leaf.

facts.fact: Jingling 辩解说那完全是另一回事，她不要长久的关系，还得顾着唱歌的事业。
facts.anchor: “That is entirely different! I don’t want something long-term, I have my singing career to think of.”

facts.fact: 姐姐本想反驳自己看男人的眼光，忽然听出“男人们”是复数。
facts.anchor: “I don’t have poor taste in… Hold on, men? Plural?”

facts.fact: 三炷香上冒的白烟互相靠拢，拧成一条辫子。
facts.anchor: The white lines of smoke rising from the three joss sticks gravitated towards each other, twisting into a braid.

facts.fact: 招到鬼就等于确认祖母已经死了。
facts.anchor: Which meant Por Por was dead.

facts.fact: 那声音耳熟，却不是祖母的，是她们母亲的。
facts.anchor: The voice was familiar, but it was not Por Por’s. It was their mother.

facts.fact: 母亲说灵媒招不了活人，人要死在前头，叫她们把这念头重想一遍。
facts.anchor: “Aiyah, did no one tell you the person has to be dead first? A spirit medium can’t summon the living; you’ll need to rethink that one.”

facts.fact: 母亲飘到供桌边，把纸钱塞进袖子，抓起最上面那只梨咬了一口。
facts.anchor: She glided over to the offerings and shoved the hell notes into her sleeves, then grabbed the topmost pear and bit into it.

facts.fact: 她让下次给她带荔枝，说自己一直馋这个。
facts.anchor: Next time get me lychee? I’ve been craving those.

facts.fact: 姐姐追问祖母为什么替南京的流民背了一笔压断腰的债。
facts.anchor: And why Por Por took out a back-breaking loan for those displaced in Nanjing?”

facts.fact: 姐姐说一家人因此连着几年天天吃红薯。
facts.anchor: “Yes, that’s why we’ve been eating sweet potatoes every day for years.”

facts.fact: 她听过洪秀全的事，人人都听过。
facts.anchor: She had heard stories of Hong Xiuquan; they all had.

facts.fact: 母亲说他们当年为了躲太平军才离开广州。
facts.anchor: “We had to leave Canton to escape the Taiping rebels.”

facts.fact: 对方要一支不会累、不会逃的兵，她真给了他一支。
facts.anchor: “He wanted an army. Soldiers who would not tire or desert him. So I gave him one.

facts.fact: 她咽下最后一口气时把裂缝合上。
facts.anchor: I closed the rift with my final breath.

facts.fact: 父亲死于救那些他根本不认识的人。
facts.anchor: but he died saving people he did not even know.

facts.fact: 她让母亲回去，说她们更聪明。
facts.anchor: “We are smarter. Go back,” she said, her words a hard line in the sand.

facts.fact: 她把妹妹的手从米碗里拽出来，握在自己两只手里捂着。
facts.anchor: Kiamling yanked Jingling’s hand from the bowl of rice, holding it between her own to warm it.

facts.fact: 母亲像针嘴饿鬼，供品摆在面前也填不满。
facts.anchor: Like a needle-mouthed hungry ghost that would never be satisfied, despite the offerings left out for her.
